title: Mousie Builder Toolkit
description: Mousie Builder Toolkit adds a set of powerful yet easy-to-use tools that make building easier and give you the freedom to create without the usual limitations.
body:
**Mousie Builder Toolkit** is a Fabric mod designed for builders who enjoy precise, flexible, and slightly impossible construction.

**Hold Left Alt** (default keybind: Open Toolkit) to open Mousie’s menu, then hover over each button for a short description. The mod introduces tools that extend vanilla Minecraft building rules, allowing block placement and editing beyond normal limitations.

The mod works in both **single-player and multiplayer**. On servers, it must be installed on both client and server, and players require operator permissions to access the full toolkit. Without OP, the menu can still be opened, but tools remain locked.

# Current Tools ![Mouse tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abb8d325208521589e44419d6ad4c83da6e04fb6.png)
- **Still Paws** – Prevents block updates, physics, fluid ticks, growth ticks, and scheduled block reactions.
- **Cheese Logic** – Allows block placement without normal support or placement restrictions.
- **Extend Tail** – Extends block interaction range with selectable distances.
- **Ruffled Fur** – Adjusts flight speed in Creative and Spectator modes.
- **Moon Sight** – Toggles Night Vision and detects existing effects from potions or commands.
- **Gamemode Buttons** – Quickly switch between Survival, Creative, Spectator, and Adventure.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

More tools and buttons will be added in future updates. Mousie is still conducting experiments that may or may not be safe for block physics.

</details>




**⚙ Controls:**
The menu key can be changed in Minecraft controls:
Options → Controls → Key Binds → Mousie Builder Toolkit → Open Toolkit.
If **Mod Menu** is installed, keybinds can also be configured through the mod’s settings screen.

## License ![Mousie reading the description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ac6501b91dbac7f3b9821cef480ed471b4d6545.png)
This mod is provided for free. It may be used in single-player and multiplayer servers, including modpacks, as long as it is not sold or redistributed as a standalone file.

### 📬 Feedback
Found a bug or have an idea for a new tool? I'd love to hear your feedback! Please send bug reports and feature suggestions to mousie.academy@gmail.com
